subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous runtime-object helpers centered on collision-quad traversal, global-state initialization, input-axis setup, force-feedback/input dispatch, cursor tracking, and setup diagnostics. The packet proves a recursive BVH traversal over surface nodes, a triangle-proximity test, a cursor scroll-tracker update, a large per-frame driver input controller tick dispatching to audio/force-feedback channel objects, two small control-state dispatchers, a large device-context-style object initializer, a vehicle setup/damage diagnostic classifier, and two dozen unconditional global-state pair/block initializers sharing identical write patterns (tag/count literal, zeroed fields, tail literal). No single owning class is evidenced; every grouping below is structural.

summary: Proposal for 32 functions spanning generic runtime objects. The packet proves a recursive BVH traversal that runs QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest on leaf nodes (with a 0xFFFE two-surface sentinel) and recurses/iterates interior nodes by split coordinate, a triangle-proximity test whose comparison body was not recovered, a cursor scroll-tracker update that clamps a center within viewport bounds and writes normalized deltas/clamped positions, a large per-frame driver input controller tick (steering/brake/throttle/rotation-FF/rumble channel dispatch plus audio sub-controller enable/disable), a control-value dispatcher, a large object initializer with three 17-count groups and 44 fixed structs, a vehicle setup/damage diagnostic classifier producing state IDs 1-109 with a label copy, and ~25 unconditional global-state initializers that write adjacent pairs or six-dword blocks with tag/zero/tail literal patterns. All owner types are UNKNOWN at packet level; class membership is GUESS.

function_roles.role: Recursive BVH (bounding-volume hierarchy) traversal for collision surface queries. Reads the node type word at this+0x8: negative marks a leaf that runs QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest (0x0044A070) against the surface pointer at this+0x10, with sentinel 0xFFFE additionally testing a second surface at surface+92. Non-negative marks an interior node: computes a split coordinate from query a2 via the axis tables indexed by the split-axis word at this+0xA (global 0x007CA3A4) with sign selection from this+0xC, recurses into the child subtree at this+0x1C when the split coordinate falls inside the child bounding interval, then walks the next sibling at this+0x20 while the coordinate stays within the next node's bound at this+0x24, re-checking the leaf sentinel after each step. Called by SpatialGridQuery (0x0044C4C0) to resolve which surfaces a query intersects.

The decompiler did not recover the comparison body; deterministic facts show the function reads the double global dbl_59EF40 (0x0059EF40), so the flags are presumed to come from a floating-point comparison involving that global. Parameters a1, a2, a3 are not referenced by the recovered body. Called by sub_44B110 (0x0044B110) as the triangle proximity test on the frame path.

Updates a cursor scroll/drag center to new input coordinates, clamps the center within viewport bounds, and writes both normalized deltas and normalized clamped positions into the tracker's float fields. Reads viewport bounds at this+0x0/0x4/0x8/0xC and per-axis scaling factors at this+0x18/0x1C; writes the center at this+0x10/0x14, normalized delta X at this+0x20, normalized delta Y at this+0x24, normalized clamped X at this+0x28 and normalized clamped Y at this+0x2C. Returns the maximum Y bound stored at this+0x4. Parameters a4/a5 are unused.

Per-frame driver input controller tick called by MainGameTickUpdate (0x0042C690). Dispatches enable/disable to four audio sub-controllers (pointers this+0x4E8/0x4EC/0x4F0/0x4F4, inner object at +0x80, vtable slot +0x58 called with argument 32 to enable / 16 to disable) gated by global byte_7C56AC and the latched init byte this+0x418; derives wheel-speed magnitudes from the player vehicle global dword_7C54E0; folds wheel-contact types into per-frame gains and flags (this+0x4D0/0x4D4/0x4D8/0x4DC/0x4E0/0x4E4); then runs a ten-channel dispatch over stride-104 records laid out from 'this' (channel live when the byte at +4 is nonzero and its object pointer at +100 is present) covering steering, brake, throttle, rotation force-feedback and rumble, computing effort/headroom/raw outputs through CRTFtol (0x00587BDC) and the feedback-curve shape helper (0x005881F0) and pushing channel messages via each channel object's vtable (+24/+28/+32). Zeroes the six rotation doubles at this+0x560..0x574 and returns 0. Owner type UNKNOWN; class membership GUESS.

Small thiscall dispatcher keyed on the control value *a2. When *a2 is 0, forwards to StructInitWithSubCall (0x004527E0) with (this, a2[1], a3) and returns its result immediately. When *a2 is 1, calls sub_452B10 (0x00452B10) with (this, a2[1], a3 == 2); if that returns non-zero, returns DeviceObjectSelector (0x00452810) with (this, a2[1]). Otherwise returns *a2 - 1.

Large object initializer (this) that zeroes several data regions, sets three axis/group count fields to 17 at this+0x27C/0x107C/0x1478, builds 44 fixed structs at this+0x1B20 via StructInitWithFixedValues (0x00452780), writes 44 {value, -1} sentinel pairs at this+0x22B0, resets state/tail fields, sets the activation byte to 1 at this+0xD7C, stores a -2 tail sentinel at this+0x2424 and a self-reference at this+0x1580, returning this. Device-context (force-feedback per existing analysis) semantics are unconfirmed.

Classifies the current vehicle setup/damage state into a numeric state ID written to a3 and copies a human-readable label from the aEmpty string table (stride 9, global 0x005C44B0) into a2. When a4 is non-zero, first fills two float scratch buffers at globals 0x007CD168 and 0x007CCA8C from per-wheel physics values; then runs ordered ConstraintForceEval (0x00454250) and SweptAABBOverlapDetection (0x004542D0) passes (indices 0-7) to assign state IDs 1-12/102-105 and 30-41/106-109; checks 16 byte-flag fields at this+0x1160..0x116F (states 13-28) and this+0x155C..0x156B (states 42-57); and evaluates two compound sign+value-match blocks gated on the sign of this+0x1180 (states 70-85) and this+0x157C (states 86-101), comparing this+0x1170/0x1174/0x1178/0x117C and this+0x156C/0x1570/0x1574/0x1578 against packet globals with bit-gate tests (& 0x100/0x200/0x400). Returns 1 with label copy when any state matched, 0 when the default -1 persisted. Sole caller is ParameterLookupWithFallback (0x00454D30).

classes.name: BoundingVolumeHierarchyTraverser
classes.responsibility: Recursively walks a bounding-volume hierarchy over collision surfaces: leaves run QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest, interior nodes split the query on an axis table and recurse into child/sibling subtrees.

classes.name: TriangleProximityTest
classes.responsibility: Boolean triangle proximity predicate; the comparison body is missing from the recovered source and the return is assembled from two status-flag captures.

classes.name: GlobalStatePairInitializer
classes.responsibility: Branch-free startup writers of two adjacent 4-byte globals (one zero, one a float bit pattern / decimal literal).

classes.name: MouseAxisGlobalInitializer
classes.responsibility: One-time initialization of mouse-absolute-axis globals (pair and block writers named InitMouseAbsAxisX / initMouseAbsoluteAxis / InitMouseAxis).

classes.name: GlobalStateBlockInitializer
classes.responsibility: Unconditional writers of contiguous multi-dword global blocks following a tag/count-first, zeroed-middle, tail-literal pattern; returns constant 0.

classes.name: CursorScrollTracker
classes.responsibility: Tracks a cursor scroll/drag center, clamps it within viewport bounds, and emits normalized deltas and normalized clamped positions scaled per axis.

classes.name: DriverInputController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame driver input controller: enables/disables four audio sub-controllers, derives wheel-speed magnitudes from the player vehicle, folds wheel-contact types into gains/flags, and dispatches steering/brake/throttle/rotation-FF/rumble channel messages through channel-object vtables.

classes.name: ControlStateDispatcher
classes.responsibility: Small control-value dispatcher: *a2==0 routes to a struct-init helper, *a2==1 routes through a compute-and-select path to a device object selector, otherwise returns *a2-1.

classes.name: DeviceContextInitializer
classes.responsibility: Large object initialization: zeroed regions, three 17-count groups, 44 fixed structs built via StructInitWithFixedValues, 44 {value, -1} sentinel pairs, activation byte and tail sentinel, ending in a self-reference.

classes.name: SetupDiagnosticClassifier
classes.responsibility: Classifies vehicle setup/damage state into numeric state IDs (1-109) using constraint-force and swept-AABB passes over scratch buffers, byte-flag fan-outs, and sign/bit-gated value-match blocks, copying a human-readable label on a match.

state_machines.name: AudioSubControllerEnableLatch
transitions: DISABLED -> ENABLED when global byte_7C56AC is nonzero and this+0x418 is clear: each audio sub-controller's inner-object vtable slot +0x58 (this+0x4E8/0x4EC/0x4F0/0x4F4 -> +0x80 -> +0) is called with argument 32 and this+0x418 is set to 1
ENABLED -> DISABLED when global byte_7C56AC is zero and this+0x418 is set: the same vtable slots are called with argument 16 and this+0x418 is cleared to 0

interfaces.name: QuadraticSurfaceCollisionTest
interfaces.purpose: Leaf-level surface collision test against a BVH node's surface pointer; also run against a second surface (surface+92) for 0xFFFE sentinel nodes.

interfaces.name: FixedStructInitializer
interfaces.purpose: Initializes an 11-dword fixed struct region during large-object construction.

interfaces.name: StructInitWithSubCall
interfaces.purpose: Initializes a struct whose head is zeroed and whose sub-pair is seeded through an inner init call; used by the control dispatcher init path.

interfaces.name: DeviceSelectionCompute
interfaces.purpose: Computes whether a device-selection step should run for a control payload; returns a boolean gating DeviceObjectSelector.

interfaces.name: DeviceObjectSelector
interfaces.purpose: Resolves/selects a device object for a control payload.

interfaces.name: ConstraintForceEvaluation
interfaces.purpose: Evaluates per-index constraint force against a float scratch buffer during setup diagnostics.

interfaces.name: SweptAABBOverlapDetection
interfaces.purpose: Detects swept AABB overlaps against a float scratch buffer during setup diagnostics.

interfaces.name: ForceFeedbackThresholdClamp
interfaces.purpose: CRTFtol-style tolerance clamp applied to force-feedback effort/headroom/raw outputs.

interfaces.name: FeedbackCurveShape
interfaces.purpose: Applies feedback-curve shaping (0.5 -> sqrt, 2.0 -> square, otherwise a linear helper) to a normalized factor.

unresolved: BVHTreeTraversal: the exact node layout mapping the packet fields (bounds at this+0x1C, next sibling at this+0x20, next bound at this+0x24) onto the raw pointer/float arithmetic follows the skeleton fill at DERIVED trust and is not independently verified here. The axis table is rendered by the raw source as both dword_7CA388 and the indexed float access unk_7CA3A4; only the single global 0x007CA3A4 is granted by the packet, so the second table address is not referenced.

TriangleProximityTest: the comparison body that sets flags c0/c2 is missing from the raw source (only the flag OR-return survived); the role of the double global dbl_59EF40 (0x0059EF40) in the comparison is inferred from deterministic facts, not from the raw text; semantics of a1/a2/a3 are unrecoverable from this body.

Global state initializers: semantic roles of every written global are not established by the packet; interpretations of the repeated literals 1065353216 (float 1.0 bit pattern) and -1082130432 (float -1.0 bit pattern) are DERIVED, not asserted. Most initializers have no static callers in the packet, so invocation context is unknown.
InitMouseAbsAxisX (0x0044CAA0): the callee RenderStateFloatInitialization has no callee evidence reference in the packet; its identity is inferred from the raw source text only. Callers are unknown.

SpatialNodeInitCe00 / GlobalStateInitializerCe60: the named callees GlobalStateInitializer_ce14() and InitFloatGlobals() have addresses absent from the packet callee facts; the 0x0044CE00->0x0044CE14 and 0x0044CE60->0x0044CE74 call edges are taken from the raw source text, not from callee facts.
InitMouseAxis (0x0044E720): the LEGACY ABI name is unverified; the globals it writes are collision-block-like, so the mouse-axis semantics may be mislabeled.

SpatialNodeInit_e300 / AudioFilterParameterDefaults / SpatialNodeInit_ea80: DERIVED labels (element count, max search distance, render threshold, filter type) are unverified; owner object identity and invocation context are unknown.

UpdateCursorScrollPosition: the exact meaning of the scale factors at this+0x18/0x1C (interpreted as reciprocal half-width/height by existing analysis) is DERIVED; parameters a4/a5 are unused; owner object and class are not evidenced; no callers recorded.

DriverInputControllerUpdateTick: three switch jump tables (0x00452668, 0x00452680, 0x00452690), a block of read-only FPU constant globals (0x0059E430..0x0059EF74) and flt_7D24A0 are listed as accessed but do not appear in the raw text; the meaning of the large channel-message constants passed to vtable slots +24/+28/+32 is not evidenced; the precise owner type and the object at +0x80 inside each sub-controller are not evidenced here.

DispatchOnControlState: the meaning of the control values in a2[0] (0 = init, 1 = compute-and-select) and the payload a2[1], and why a3 == 2 is coerced to a boolean for sub_452B10, are not established; the owning object and the device-selection domain are unidentified.

MemoryAllocation_31a0: exact device-context semantics (force-feedback per existing analysis) are not provable from this packet alone; the 17 axis count and the role of the 44 fixed structs and 44 {value, -1} sentinel pairs are unconfirmed; region memsets at this+0x4, this+0xCBC, this+0xD88, this+0x1184, this+0x1580 have no per-field evidence refs.

ClassifySetupDiagnosticState: the semantic meaning of each numeric state ID (1-109) and of the aEmpty label table is not derivable from this packet; the float scratch fills read offsets this+3428/3460/4288/5308 that are not listed as named fields; the a2 label-table relationship assumes aEmpty has 9-byte entries whose content is not in this packet.
InitFloatGlobals (0x0044CE74): the decimal literal 1065353216 stored to dword_7CA454 has no established interpretation and the calling context is absent from the packet; the owning object is unknown.
InitFloatConstants (0x0044CED4): the decimal literal -1082130432 stored to dword_7CCBFC has no established interpretation; calling context and owner are unknown.
GlobalStateInitializer_cf34: the decimal literal 1065353216 stored to dword_7CA3B4 has no established interpretation; calling context and owner are unknown.

Class grouping is structural: ABI names suggesting semantic domains (SpatialNode, Audio, Mouse, Scoring, Input) are unverified, and equal offsets on unrelated 'this' pointers (e.g. 0x0-0x2C used by both BVHTreeTraversal and UpdateCursorScrollPosition) are not merged across classes.
